avoid: uses Character Offset, which shows wrong or missing glyphs on Hindi/Devanagari (and other non-Latin scripts) while it animates
Echo trails look muddy on long text

Hindi/Devanagari (measured 2026-10-13): per-character animators split dependent vowel signs (matras) from their consonants mid-animation, though the settled text shapes correctly; for Hindi animate per word or per line (Range Selector Based On: Words or Lines, or a By Word / By Line preset)
cards.duration_note: Range Selector Offset keyed -100 -> 100 over 2.5 s, from comp.time to comp.time + 2.5 s. The .ffx stores the keys at +1.0 .. +3.5 s, but applyPreset puts the first stored key at comp.time, so the gallery render (preset applied at 0 s) shows the animation already under way at +0.5 s.
cards.scripting: Text layer only. comp.openInViewer(); comp.time = <start seconds>; make the text layer the only selected layer; layer.applyPreset(new File(<file>)). Keyframes are written starting at comp.time; durations in duration_note were read from the .ffx keyframes (+/- 0.01 s). Adds an Echo effect (Echo Time +0.25 s, about 3 echoes, Decay 0.5) for the ghosting; a positive Echo Time takes echoes from later frames, so the ghosts lead the falling letters - set Echo Time negative for classic trails, or remove the effect for a cleaner fall. Character range is Full Unicode.
